title: Alien Thunder
summary: Noise cracks over a low, metallic oscillator rumble, then decays through a slowly moving resonant filter like thunder from an unfamiliar atmosphere.

settings: X/Y/Z are upper knobs left to right; A/B are lower buttons. Press A to run.
X: 15% (about 87 BPM); keep above minimum because minimum selects external sync.
Z: 35% randomness for changing gaps. Y and both pitch CV outputs are unused; PULSE supplies 20 ms gates.

sound: A noise impact decays over low oscillators. Audio-rate FM adds a metallic undertone and slow filter motion changes its apparent distance. Cutoff at 60% was confirmed; other values are starting points.
setup: Make the five numbered connections. Six dashed routes are built in; the headphone lead is separate. Select Sequencer mode, keep X above minimum, press A, and begin with output volume low.
VCO 2's middle output must produce noise. If it produces a sub-oscillator, its internal selector is configured for SUB.
play: Decay controls the body and release the distant tail. Brain tempo/randomness set storm spacing; cutoff controls distance; LFO RATE adds atmospheric motion.
variations: Remove cable 5 for natural thunder. Mixer 3 controls crack versus rumble. Raise resonance cautiously for a pitched sci-fi ring.

normalled_policy: N1-N6 retain the built-in oscillator-to-mixer, mixer-to-filter, filter-to-VCA 1, ENV 1-to-control, and VCA 1-to-output chain. Cables add noise, gate, two filter modulations, and FM. Mixer IN4 is silenced.

vco1.width.irrelevant: Saw selected; pulse width does not affect this waveform.

vco2.width.irrelevant: Saw selected; pulse width does not affect this waveform.

mixer.gain4.irrelevant: Mixer input 4 is unused and its level is zero.

mixer.threshold.irrelevant: No signal enters sidechain input 4, so compression is inactive.

brain.y.irrelevant: Octave range affects unused pitch CV outputs, not PULSE.
